core_features: Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) loop: Target Agent → frozen Benchmark → isolated evaluation → Candidate → accept/rollback, with versioned snapshot before every round
Agents build agents — penguin-sdk skill builds a self-contained app (RAG recipe included) whose embedded agent's AGENTS.md becomes the persona
Unified LLM API + 1000+ model adapters (DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, GPT, Gemini, Claude, Inkling + any OpenAI-protocol endpoint)
Append-only JSONL Trace per Session, designed for crash-torn-tail recovery
Plugin library (17 plugins, 4 categories) shipped as plain files (plugin.json + skills/<n>/SKILL.md + hooks/*.mjs) — files-are-truth, no caching
Goal mode (background hook: start.mjs writes GOAL.json, stop.mjs reads Trace, dispatches next round) and continual learning (background subagent folds long-task findings into skills)
Agent Company mode (CEO/HR/Finance/Researcher/Mirror digital twins, all-hands channel for board approval)
architecture_layers: packages/core (@prismshadow/penguin-core) — SDK: context_engine, OmniMessage protocol, Agent/Session/Plugin loader, Trace writer, hooks runner. The whole library is here; everything else is a thin host.
packages/cli (@prismshadow/penguin-cli) — commander-based CLI; run/chat/server/web/config. A thin client over the HTTP API.
packages/server (@prismshadow/penguin-server) — HTTP/SSE backend that CLI/Desktop/Web all talk to. Imported as @prismshadow/penguin-server/lock for the live-server lock.

packages/desktop — Electron shell. Forks penguin-server as utilityProcess on shared data root; one BrowserWindow over http://localhost:<port>; no preload, no node integration; tray icon; HMR layer (mechanism only — see packages/hmr).
packages/web — Vite/React SPA the server serves; same-origin over the embedded HTTP.
packages/hmr — runtime hot-update of platform code via POST /api/hmr/upgrade pushing a CLI bundle into an HMR store.
packages/docs — docs site content (referenced by SKILL.md / docs paths).

plugins/ — 17 npm packages (@penguinharness/<name>), each its own self-contained content directory (plugin.json + skills/ + hooks/); resolved through Node from core's dependency list; source-of-truth on disk, no build step.
distinguishing_features: The 'Optimizer' and 'Evaluator' are not TypeScript modules — they are agents running SKILL.md protocols. agent-tuning ships four skills: agent-initialization, benchmark-design, agent-evaluation, agent-optimization. The Optimizer is an agent following plugins/agent-tuning/skills/agent-optimization/SKILL.md.

Scoreboard is a YAML file (benchmarks/<id>/scoreboard.yaml) that is authoritative: 'do not add a server, frontend, script, or consistency check that recomputes or validates them.' (agent-optimization/SKILL.md:129).
Snapshot-before-every-round: agent_state/ is archived into <target>/snapshots/v<version>.tar.gz atomically (excluding .vault.toml). Reject restores the previous Reference from that archive.

Trace writer uses single write(2) on O_APPEND — explicitly avoids Node's appendFile 512 KiB chunking because a torn 512KB chunk glues onto every later record and breaks the whole file (writer.ts:71-101).

Privacy boundary in evaluation: Test Agent sees only statement/, never rubric/, gold answers, or scoring rules. Optimizer never sees evaluator private state. Contamination rule: if private info enters optimizer context, restore active Candidate and stop.

Skills install = drop a SKILL.md under agent_state/skills/<n>/. Frontmatter (name + description) is auto-injected into system prompt; full body is 'index first, body on demand' — agent reads SKILL.md via shell when it actually needs it (agent-initialization/SKILL.md:46-65).
Goal mode + continual learning are hook packages (Node scripts), not core logic. start.mjs writes GOAL.json; stop.mjs reads Trace and decides next round.

weaknesses: Scoreboard YAML is authoritative but human-editable — no DB transaction; concurrent writers could clobber. They compensate by 'append and verify before reporting success'.
Snapshot is a tar.gz (excludes .vault.toml), so secrets aren't snapshotted but recovery needs the vault separately. Restoring across machines is not addressed.
Plugin loader reads files on every call (no caching) — fine because files are small and calls infrequent, but cold-start library scans touch 17 plugins × multiple files each.
Trace writer's torn-tail heal inserts a literal blank line that 'every reader ignores' — depends on tolerant readers; a strict parser breaks.

Two separate protocol versions for Optimizer↔Evaluator communication (plain YAML over subagent) and Optimizer↔LLM (skill instructions) — easy to drift; the SKILL.md pins specific phrases ('Return only the clean YAML').
Goal mode + continual learning are Node hook scripts — no sandboxing beyond the host's command approval; a malformed stop.mjs can stall the loop.
Desktop is Electron + utilityProcess — RAM cost > TUI/REST-only.
Workers in agent-evaluation never see the rubric, but the Optimizer doesn't run tests against the evaluator's scoring model itself, so evaluator drift is silent.
